name: progress
title: Progress
description: UI SDK Progress: a task's progress, determinate or indeterminate, with label and value.
docs: The value reads in the page's locale by default, as CLDR writes it: es-ES, fr-FR and de-DE put a no-break space (U+00A0) before the percent sign ("21 %"), en-US none. `format` on the root (`Intl.NumberFormat` options, or a function of the value) changes the visible value and what screen readers hear together, and `locale` pins the locale. `formatValue={(value, { min, max, percent, text }) => …}` on the Value part replaces only the visible value (a node, so it can hold markup), while screen readers keep the root's text; use `getValueLabel` on the root to change theirs. While the bar is indeterminate `value` and `percent` are null.
